title: Harvesting
description: Harvest crops at maximum maturity level under dry weather conditions.

title: Cleaning & Sorting
description: Remove stones, debris, damaged grains, or spoiled fruits from crop harvest batches.

title: Moisture Drying
description: Reduce seed moisture levels to below critical boundaries (e.g. 12% for grains) to inhibit fungal growth.
animation_text: Driers warming up... Dry state reached.

title: Disinfection
description: Sanitize containers and warehouse bays. Treat seeds with biological protectants.

title: Warehousing & Silo Storing
description: Store inside hermetic silos or cold preservation chambers based on crop guidelines.

title: Telemetry Monitoring
description: Keep monitoring temperature and humidity sensors regularly using the digital dashboard.
